children: Show up. Get strong. No ego.
A strength & conditioning studio built on small groups, real coaching and loads that meet you where you are. Every level scaled. Every session coached. Claim your spot.

First week or tenth year, the workout bends to you. We scale the weight and the movement so it’s the right kind of hard for your body today.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Forge is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A lifter mid-set under a loaded barbell in a dark gym

children: Built for people, not personal records they’ll never chase

Forge started because the big-box gym wasn’t working — no coaching, no plan, no one who noticed if you showed up or quit. So we built the opposite: small groups, real programming, and coaches who know your name and your numbers.

Strong isn’t a look here, it’s a habit. We keep classes capped and the ego at the door so the person on their first day trains next to the person on their thousandth, and both leave better than they came.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: A certified coach runs every session — cueing form, scaling load and keeping you honest. You’re never just clocking time on a machine.
Strength that adds weight over blocks, conditioning that builds an engine, deloads before you’re fried. It’s written, tracked and it moves your numbers.
Every workout scales up or down on the spot. Injury, first week, off day — we adjust the movement and the load so it’s the right hard for you.
